title: pvResourceImageTexture
body:
## pvResourceImageTexture

Typed texture resource (vtkTexture) that loads its image from a file such as a PNG or JPEG. It produces no dataset: other nodes reference it through texture inputs, currently pvLogo's Texture port, and several consumers may share it. Use it when the picture is a file on disk; use pvResourceTexture when the image comes from a pipeline node.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- FileName is required and is read by ParaView's image reader; unsupported image formats fail at update.
- Exercised by examples/schemaxis/paraview-textures.json (receipt in verification/2026-09-16-catalogue-expansion.json); other settings are unverified.

Native constructor: `ImageTexture`. Identity: `textures/ImageTexture`. Role: `resource`. Output kinds: `["texture"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ColorMode` | When color mode is Default, 8-bits textures is equivalent to Direct Scalars, while equivalent to Map Scalars for 16-bits textures. In the case of Map Scalars, all the values are mapped to a generic color map. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Default","Map Scalars","Direct Scalars"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Default"` |
| `FileName` | Set the name of image file to load. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `Mode` | Set the mode in which image data is read. | `{"type":"enum","values":["ReadFromFile","ReadFromMemory"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"ReadFromFile"` |
| `RestrictPowerOf2ImageSmaller` | Rendering-only choice used when an image exceeds the graphics card's maximum texture size and must be resampled to power-of-two dimensions: true rounds each dimension down (smaller, blurrier texture), false rounds up. It never changes the image data that consumers such as pvLogo receive. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `TrivialProducerKey` | Set the key used to locate the image data object on the server. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "process-local typed native resource",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvResourceImageTexture",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
